Title: Old Stone Remembers
Description: Desperate for a way to banish the cruel voice in your head, follow the rambling musings of the old hermit Yonas by seeking the wisdom of old stone carvings.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Only those who seek misery would ask such a thing. You should banish your misery, like I have banished mine.
InProgressResponse: Words immortalized in stone. It helps trap the ghosts… Ghosts of remembering.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />I hear my own voice, faint but in chorus with the ghosts here.

Title: Strength of a Soul
Description: To Learn more about the Soulwardens, face the Wardens' trials in the Tomb of the Old Warrior.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />A valiant effort to stem the tide, perhaps, or <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />more likely to simply take a stand against the inevitable.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />You will know when you have found your resolve. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Until then, I have nothing more to offer you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Well, imagine the kinds of people you run into on the roads around here.

Title: Talk of the Town
Description: Yonas appears to have left you at the ruins, but luckily Grace O'Malley saw him pass by toward the town of Oxboro. Ask around to see if anyone has seen where he went off to.
PlayerPrompt: "Yes. Did you see an old man?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />Now that you mention it, there was an old codger a few paces back. <g id="male_gestureBackThere" priority="high" />They’ve got a proper city that direction. I'll be going back soon enough.
InProgressResponse: A lot can be gleaned from the locals. Especially when it comes to strangers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I would ask you to walk softly, but the fish are already wise to me. Travel on, stranger.

Title: The Last Soulwarden
Description: Seek answers about the Soulwardens' fate within the tower Arcturus.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Oh? Did I abandon you, or did I just walk ahead? I walk a great deal you know, and sometimes, my memories stay behind.
InProgressResponse: Arcturus. Yes, that's what it's called. Is it a safe place? I believe it was once.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />You have been to the tower then, have you? <g id="sit_headshakeno" />The ghosts of my fellow Wardens call from there, demanding that I remember.

Title: Speaker of the Angry Earth
Description: Yonas Alazar says that if you want to become a Soulwarden, you'll need a living seed from the Angry Earth. Yonas recalls a woman in the wildnerness, elusive as a shadow, that may be able to help you acquire such a thing, if you can find her.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />That is a… terrible idea. <g id="sit_headshakeno" />The process required to harden one's soul against Corruption demands <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />a sacrifice you cannot imagine.
InProgressResponse: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Even if you do manage to track this Huntress down, have no expectations. <g id="sit_headshakeno" />She's not fond of other people, as I recall.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />You tread on what was once hallowed ground, human. Whatever your purpose coming here, it is misguided. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Go back to your settlement.

Title: The Daughterwell
Description: Explore the Canary Mine and purge any Corrupted manifestations might be blocking the flow of Azoth to Adiana's fountain in the Daughterwell.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_shakehead" />You are wasting your time and mine.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Contamination still clogs the fountain. We have nothing to say to you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handheart" />We are grateful for your role in restoring the fountain, but <g id="female_youknow" />you should know that the Angry Earth is capable of defending itself against Corruption.

Title: Weakness of the Ego
Description: Use Adiana's recipe to gather the ingredients to craft a tincture that will dampen the effects of Corruption.
PlayerPrompt: "I need a seed of the Angry Earth."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />Hah. Do you even realize how much you ask? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />How much your kind has already taken?
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Have you made the tincture I taught you yet? You're going to need it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodding" />There now, that will afford you some protection, whether or not your request for the Seed is granted.

Title: Plans of the Pestilent
Description: Adiana Theron suspects the Corrupted of Ebonrock Armory are looking for something. Thin their forces and determine their purpose there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_gestureright" priority="high" />The Ebonrock Caverns nearby are overrun with the Corrupted.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Red eyes in the dark, watching night and day from the Ebonrock Caverns. Purge those you can and find out what it is they seek.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_gestureleft"/>My companion has told me all that transpired in the cavern. <g id="male_willcoverit" bin="1" />Not even I knew of the shrine the Angry Earth harbored there.

Title: A Living Conduit
Description: Adiana Theron has seen fit to grant you a seed of power, a fitting conduit for the weapon of a Soulwarden. Return to Yonas Alazar with news of your success.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_chuckle" priority="high" />It grants what your kind lacks - <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />a connection to the Earth itself.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />You have what you need, so begone from here. <g id="male_shakehead" />This is no longer a place for humans.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />It is a relief to see you return. Though my heart trembles to harbor hope again, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />it's too late to turn back.

Title: The Implement of a Soulwarden
Description: In search of the haft for your Azoth Staff, Yonas indicates the existence a hidden, secret cache within the hidden interior of Canis.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Yes. The relationship between Azoth and the soul is complex, but <g id="litearmor_agree1" />it is this dynamic that gives a Soulwarden their strength.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />We knew the tide was turning against us. I realize now, <g id="litearmor_agree1" />we created the caches in the hope that a day like this might arrive.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high"/>Well now, it's been an age since I laid eyes on one of these. It brings back many memories… <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />not all of them painful either.

Title: Forgemaster's Legacy
Description: Search the Ancient ruin of Vulcanus for the materials to craft the Crosspiece of your Azoth Staff.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Yes, you may need to be resourceful. To the west, you will find the ancient structure that houses the forge. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />It was used by the Soulwarden Order even before my time, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />so you may still find materials scattered throughout.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Mind you, tread lightly, young one. Such places belong to the past, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />and the past has a habit of fighting back on this island.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high" />I see you managed it after all. A fine crosspiece, almost as fine as Forgemaster Ezra once made. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Did you have any trouble?

Title: An Order Reborn
Description: With the components of an ancient Soulwarden staff in hand, proceed to the forge beneath Shattered Obelisk. There, you will reignite the flame of the Soulwarden Order by bringing a new Azoth Staff into being.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I do not know. <g id="litearmor_worry" />The traveler said the Corrupted rally around something called "The Tempest," a being they worship like a god.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_converseright" />Find the altar near the Shattered Obelisk. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />That is where the Staff-forging ritual must take place.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Welcome back. And look at you! Still as fresh as a newborn babe.

Title: The Defense of Everfall
Description: Deliver news of hope to the people of Everfall. The staff in your hands carries with it the power to destroy Corruption at its roots.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I think so. Go back to Oxboro. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Shout from the rooftops. Bang pots and pans if you must.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />The strength of men will but stall the Corrupted threat. <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />The staff you hold is the only way to permanently destroy the physical manifestations of Corruption.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_bowShallow" />A fine day to you, traveler. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I trust your meeting with the Constable was mutually beneficial. <g id="male_converseleft" />Was there anything I can offer you to support your interests?

Title: The Invasion of Everfall
Description: Though the townsfolk of Everfall refuse to help themselves, you have the means to protect them. Guard Captain Franc Dubois offers moral support for your quest to battle the Corrupted in Northern Everfall. He simply asks you to keep an eye out for Herbalist Howe during your travels.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_shocked" />Why, you haven't heard? Impossible! There's a devastating shortage of herbs! <g id="female_explains" />Many of our wealthiest citizens depend on such herbs for happiness and health.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />For Oxboro, it is a crisis of the highest order. So by all means, <g id="male_willcoverit" />your campaign gets my full moral support, but <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />do look out for Howe. <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Good luck!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />The staff has done its work- I can taste it in the air. <g id="female_nodyes" /> Consecrated ground will repel the Corrupted for a time.

Title: Destiny Unearthed
Description: Acquire a Heartgem, meant to shield your soul against the effects of Corruption. Search southern Everfall for rare reagents needed to create a new Heartgem.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_compliment" />You must acquire a Heartgem - your defense against Corruption - a vessel you'll use to <g id="male_handheart" />encase your soul and protect it, a cold vault within your chest.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />Just as the Azoth Staff is the extension of the Soulwarden's strength, <g id="male_willcoverit" />the Heartgem is the source of the Soulwarden's defenses.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_takeAndGiveItem8s" priority="high"/>Look at that - an empty Heartgem. Almost brings a tear to my eye. Take a good look, because this thing is going to <g id="male_nodunderstand" />become part of you forever.

Title: The Ritual
Description: Complete the ritual deep in Amrine Temple to conquer death and become a Soulwarden in full.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_shakehead" />Not entirely. You can still fall to temptation or rage, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but it offers protection, a buffer.
InProgressResponse: Don't worry too much about the ritual. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />You know you're going to die, so it can't be any worse, can it? <g id="male_realize" />In all honesty, it probably can, but let's pretend.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_bowDeepHandsfolded" priority="high" bout="1.5"/>Welcome back, Soulwarden. You are now part of a legacy <g id="female_nodyes" />that goes back beyond the reach of history.
